DRD1.therapeutic_rationale: Direct D1-MSN 'Go' pathway antagonist (Phase 3 D1AMOND Ecopipam mechanism) sparing D2 extrapyramidal liability.

DRD2.therapeutic_rationale: Indirect D2-MSN 'No-Go' & mesolimbic antipsychotic benchmark (FDA-approved for both Tourette Syndrome and Schizophrenia).

VMAT2.therapeutic_rationale: Presynaptic vesicular monoamine transporter 2 (SLC18A2) lumen-facing inhibitor attenuating hyperkinetic striatal dopamine release.

HRH3.therapeutic_rationale: Genetically validated Tourette target (HDC W317X loss-of-function); presynaptic H3 inverse agonism restores central striatal histamine tone.

PDE10A.therapeutic_rationale: Striatal MSN cAMP/cGMP catalytic inhibitor (Phase 2b Allevia-2 TS mechanism) activating indirect D2-MSN braking without direct D2 blockade.

GABRA5.therapeutic_rationale: Multi-chain GABA-A alpha5+/gamma2- extracellular allosteric partial PAM compensating for striatal PV+ GABAergic interneuron deficits, sparing alpha1 sedation.

GAT1.therapeutic_rationale: Human WT SLC6A1 GABA reuptake inhibitor elevating synaptic GABAergic impulse braking across striatum, GPe/GPi, and motor cortex.

ADORA2A.therapeutic_rationale: Active miniGs-coupled striatopallidal A2A-D2 heteromer agonist (non-ribose CNS-penetrant archetype) allosterically trans-inhibiting D2 hyperactivity.

GRM5.therapeutic_rationale: Non-alkyne mGluR5 7TM negative allosteric modulator dampening hyper-glutamatergic corticostriatal & subthalamic tic drive without acetylene GSH-adduct alerts.

DRD3.therapeutic_rationale: Limbic D3-preferring antagonist/partial agonist addressing Schizophrenia negative symptoms and reward-circuit dysfunction.

HTR2A.therapeutic_rationale: Selective 5-HT2A inverse agonist/antipsychotic (Lumateperone/Pimavanserin axis) strictly counter-screened against 5-HT2B cardiac valvulopathy.

CHRM1.therapeutic_rationale: Active Gq/11 muscarinic M1 pro-cognitive & antipsychotic agonist (Cobenfy / ML-007C axis) sparing peripheral M3 cholinergic toxicity.

CHRM4.therapeutic_rationale: Active Gi1-coupled muscarinic M4 non-D2 striatal brake (FDA-approved Cobenfy mechanism) counter-screened against peripheral CHRM3.

TAAR1.therapeutic_rationale: Active Gs-coupled non-D2 antipsychotic mechanism dampening mesolimbic DA/5-HT hyperactivity (Ulotaront cryo-EM pocket 8W88).

GPR52.therapeutic_rationale: Active Gs-coupled striatal D2-MSN orphan GPCR side-pocket agonist providing non-basic-amine indirect-pathway antipsychotic & anti-tic modulation.
